output.title: Scale on busy threads
output.description: CPU stays low while threads wait on a slow partner, so CPU scaling never adds pods. Compare: scale on busy threads (up to 10 pods), or free the thread while waiting. The partner's replies vary by 10%.

simulations.title: Threads held: CPU says all is well
simulations.description: At 400 requests/s the 64 threads fill. CPU scaling stays at four replicas while Applications pile up.

simulations.title: Scale on busy threads
simulations.description: Scale at 70% of threads per pod: more pods start within ten seconds and the lag drains.

simulations.title: Free the thread while waiting
simulations.description: The same traffic runs on four pods when waiting calls free their threads.

scalingPlans.title: Threads held: CPU says all is well

suggestions.explanation: In “Threads held: CPU says all is well”, more than half the busy threads are waiting. Scale on busy threads (modelled custom metric). A rerun with this change confirmed it.
